description: Returns educational content (sections, citations, quiz preview) for one of 9 learning modules: Investing Primer, Alternative Investing, Behavioral Economics, Gender and Behavioral Investing, DeFi, Art as Investment, Climate/ESG & Real World Assets, DeFi Investing, and Kahlo x Basquiat. The Investing Primer is returned in full; each other module returns its first section(s) and first quiz, with the remaining sections listed by title. Narrative educational content only.

module_id.description: Module id or title (e.g. 'mod_art', 'Art as Investment', 'mod_defi_investing', 'DeFi Investing')
